config_status: evidence reconstruction for the locally present keyed run; the historical paired run manifest is absent
unknown_value_policy: The literal string 'unknown' means the available manuscript and local archive do not establish the value. It is not a default.

applies_to.identity_warning: The local keyed-only values differ slightly from the manuscript keyed values and must not be substituted for them.

filters: movie has Tag Genome data for the selected-tag processing universe

split.type: global chronological split after filtering positive ratings to Tag Genome movies
split.test_user_selection: If more than 10000 unique users occur in the global test partition, take the first 10000 unique user indices in test-row order; then retain the first test row per selected user.
split.selection_seed: not used by the documented selection code

candidate_rows.construction_order: held-out positive at column 0, followed by sampled negatives
candidate_rows.negative_sampling_distribution: uniform without replacement from the eligible active-item set
negative_exclusions: items in the user's training history
not_excluded_by_the_local_script: items in the user's validation history
other items in the user's test history

scores.RawCount: dot product of user tag-history counts and candidate binary tag attributes
scores.Centered count: tag-history score using item tags centered by their item-universe mean

reported: Hit@10 (equivalently Recall@10 for one relevant item)

tie_policies.stable_manuscript_policy: descending primary score with input order retained inside exact ties

keyed_local_implementation.guarantee_qualification: Casting the secondary key to float32 permits collisions. Equal primary and secondary keys can retain input-order dependence, and no historical collision audit is preserved.
keyed_local_implementation.implementation_summary: unsigned 64-bit mixing with wraparound, normalized by 2^64, cast to float32, then used as the ascending secondary key in lexicographic sorting
keyed_local_implementation.collision_rule_in_historical_implementat: No explicit final identity key. Equal float32 keys are passed to NumPy lexsort/argsort behavior, so the resulting order can depend on input layout and sorting implementation.

missing_historical_inputs: per-row primary scores and relevance labels
exact software environment for the historical paired audit
source_records: local MovieLens Tag Genome experiment script
